signal: Tessell raised $60M Series B led by WestBridge Capital to expand AI-driven multi-cloud data management and named new executives in May 2026 to accelerate enterprise database modernization

email.body1:
Jayson, saw Tessell close $60M and bring on new execs to accelerate enterprise database modernization.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before the new leaders set targets, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Tessell off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jayson, quick follow-up for Tessell.

Post-raise with a new leadership bench, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Tessell needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps to close it.
email.body3:
Jayson, last bit of proof for Tessell.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Tessell's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jayson, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters right after a raise with a new bench settling in, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Tessell either way.
